description: This Java source file defines an abstract class 'EventBusCredentialsAdapter' that acts as an adapter to connect a CredentialsService to the Vert.x event bus, enabling message-based request handling for credentials operations such as 'get'. The class includes methods for processing incoming request messages, extracting parameters, creating tracing spans, and delegating to the underlying CredentialsService. It also provides support for custom operations and error handling.

classes.name: EventBusCredentialsAdapter
classes.description: Abstract adapter class that facilitates routing of credentials-related requests received over the Vert.x event bus to the underlying CredentialsService, with support for tracing and error handling.

methods.name: processRequest
methods.description: Handles incoming EventBusMessage requests by determining the operation type and dispatching to the appropriate handler, such as processGetRequest or custom handlers.

methods.name: processGetRequest
methods.description: Processes 'get Credentials' requests, extracts relevant parameters, creates tracing spans, and delegates to specific methods based on search criteria.

methods.name: processGetByDeviceIdRequest
methods.description: Stub method for handling credential retrieval by device ID; intended to be overridden by subclasses.

methods.name: processGetByAuthIdRequest
methods.description: Performs credential retrieval based on auth ID, sets tracing tags, calls the CredentialsService, and constructs the response message.

methods.name: newChildSpan
methods.description: Creates a new tracing span with tags for tenant and operation, used for tracing the lifecycle of a credentials request.

methods.name: processCustomCredentialsMessage
methods.description: Default handler for unsupported custom operations, returns a 'Bad Request' error.
